chars.T: TEACHER: a young man in a slim charcoal grey suit, white shirt, thin black tie and square black glasses.
chars.K: KHALID: a man wearing a long white Gulf thobe and a red-and-white checkered keffiyeh headdress held by a black agal ring, dark sunglasses.
chars.A: APPLICANT: a young man in a mustard yellow hoodie and blue jeans, holding a green folder.
chars.S: SECRETARY: a young woman in a burgundy blazer and black skirt wearing a headset.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A rented office in Tangier, Morocco. KHALID sits behind a big desk like a rich boss with a smug grin, TEACHER stands beside him with a sly look, and the nervous APPLICANT sits across the desk clutching his folder, sweating, hoping for the job. Tense mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A long crowded corridor of a Tangier office building, many young Moroccan job seekers in a queue holding folders and papers, the APPLICANT in front looking hopeful. Busy, excited crowd.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: TEACHER sits at a desk interviewing the APPLICANT, gesturing confidently like a professional recruiter while the APPLICANT answers nervously. Modern office with a window showing Tangier rooftops.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a back room, TEACHER helps KHALID adjust his Gulf headdress in front of a mirror; KHALID poses proudly like a rich Gulf businessman, both smirking conspiratorially.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Office reception entrance: the SECRETARY stands at the door politely welcoming the APPLICANT with a professional smile, potted plants and a clean reception desk. Everything looks very professional.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: KHALID shakes the APPLICANT's hand in congratulation while TEACHER claps; the APPLICANT jumps with joy, tears of happiness. Office background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The APPLICANT happily hands his passport to TEACHER across the desk; TEACHER takes it with a fake warm smile, a pile of passports on the desk.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: KHALID leans forward over the desk pointing a finger seriously at the APPLICANT, whose smile freezes into worry as he reaches for his wallet. Suspenseful dark lighting.
